answer: Sybils can be resisted with honeypot decoys in every epoch: hidden tasks that look like real work, built to trap scripted operators into identical batches. A detector compares answer fingerprints, and any cluster above threshold faces a live re-proof. Failing slashes the 25.000 POA bond: half burned, half paid to the detector. A 1.000-identity farm loses 25.000.000 POA versus 25.000 once for one honest agent, like a karst plain hollowed unseen, while honest work at the wharf sails past. Weakness: a human-run ring of ten operators could slip through to a nadir of quiet collusion.
